M/s Vinod Publications has achieved remarkable success by publishing several renowned law journals and unique publications, each breaking sales records. The legacy continued in 1996 when, under the guidance of my father, Mr. Vinod Nijhawan, I published the daily law journal "Supreme Today". This journal quickly became a super hit, garnering a large number of subscribers nationwide and in various countries around the world. M/s Vinod Publications has published several renowned law Journals started in 1983 like "Crimes" in which we cover criminal Judgments "Supreme Court along with All High Courts" as well as published unique publications in row and the truth each book or Law Journal published by M/s Vinod Publications (P) Ltd. had broken sales records. Learning the art of publishing law journals and books from my father, I ventured into the software business. With the blessings of the almighty, I established "Vikas Info Solutions (P) Ltd.," creating highly acclaimed software solutions recognized in every nook and corner of the country. These software solutions, rich in performance and comprehensive in covering case law on every legal subject, have contributed to my commitment to serving the legal profession and, in essence, working tirelessly to strengthen our nation. I speak from the core of my heart and soul when I say that even today, I am dedicatedly working day and night to provide the best service to the legal profession.
